Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Sunday, April 26, 2026 10:40 AM – We received 2-4" of new snow in the past 24 hours. It's currently cloudy at Main Lodge, with strong winds and cold temps. A low-hanging cloud is covering mid to upper mountain terrain, limiting visibility. 12 lifts are currently open, with 5 additional lifts delayed or on weather holds. See below for detailed expectations. Canyon Lodge is open for access only today. Canyon Express (16) and the Village Gondola will spin, with rentals, tickets, retail, and parking available. Beginner skiers and riders should plan to ski out of Main Lodge for the best experience. Roller Coaster Express (4) will be closed midweek, reopening Friday, May 1. Chair 13 and Chair 14 will close for the season after today.  
   
Conditions and Visibility: Cloudy skies, temps in the 20s, and strong winds.   
Lift status: We currently have 12 lifts spinning, with 4 additional lifts on weather holds.  
 
Broadway Express (1), Stump Alley Express (2), Face Lift Express (3), Roller Coaster Express (4), High Five Express (5), Unbound Express (6), Gold Rush Express (10), Discovery Express (11), Chair 12, Canyon Express (16), the Lower Panorama Gondola, and the Village Gondola are currently spinning.
 
Chairs 13, 14, 23 and the Upper Panorama Gondola are on weather holds.  
  
Roller Coaster Express (4) will be closed midweek, reopening Friday, May 1. Chair 13, Chair 14, Canyon Express (16), and the Village Gondola will close for the season after today.  
  
Please note, Chair 7, Chair 8, Cloud Nine Express (9), Eagle Express (15), Schoolyard Express (17), Chair 20, Chair 21, Chair 22, and Chair 25 have wrapped up operations for the season. Eagle Lodge is now closed for the season.   
Winter Activity status: Sno-Go Ski Bike Tours are available Sunday-Thursday, weather permitting. Woolly’s Adventure Summit is closed for the winter season and is scheduled to reopen May 22 for the summer. Tamarack Cross-Country Ski Center and Snowmobile Adventures are closed for the season.
Safety: Please put the bar down. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611   
Road Conditions: Roads are covered in snow and ice, so please drive with caution. Consider taking the free Mountain Shuttle to the mountain this morning, with service from around Mammoth Lakes to Main and Canyon Lodges. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.
